quests.title: Wangshu Take-Away

dialogue.sit: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

dialogue.t: Well aren't you a busy one? No problem, I'll get someone else to help me out.
Well, aren't you straightforward... Well, best hurry, then — and be sure not to touch any weird stuff while you're at it.
Right, and remember not to use your glider to rush things. If you scatter the meat rolls when you land, the customer isn't taking it.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogue.t: Ah, I'm hungry... *sigh* I wonder where my order's gone off too?

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: What, you here to lend me a hand?
Well, you're just in time. Someone named Ling'guan ordered a Matsutake Meat Roll from me.
She wanted me to send it to some spot northwest of Dihua Marsh. The Mora's already been paid out, too.
Well, if you've got time, how about helping me deliver it? You'll be compensated.
Oh, you're here at last. Thanks a lot!
I was just thinking that I should head back to Wangshu Inn to check in on my order, too...

quests.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...
